-- All orders created today (Lagos time)
select
  count(*)::int                                                                   as total_orders,
  coalesce(sum(total_amount) filter (where order_status <> 'INCOMPLETE'), 0)::float8 as total_value,
  count(*) filter (where 'HIGH_VALUE_ORDER' = any(tags))::int                     as high_value_orders,
  count(*) filter (where payment_status = 'PAYMENT_PENDING'
                     and order_status in ('RECEIVED','UNDER_REVIEW'))::int        as awaiting_payment,
  count(*) filter (where payment_status = 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED')::int               as paid_orders,
  coalesce(sum(amount_paid) filter (where payment_status = 'PAYMENT_CONFIRMED'), 0)::float8 as total_paid,
  count(*) filter (where bonus_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT')::int                   as bonuses_pending,
  coalesce(sum(bonus_amount) filter (where bonus_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'), 0)::float8 as bonus_value_pending,
  count(*) filter (where order_status = 'UNDER_REVIEW')::int                      as under_review,
  count(*) filter (where order_status = 'INCOMPLETE')::int                        as incomplete
from orders
where created_at >= (date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'Africa/Lagos') at time zone 'Africa/Lagos');
